gallery.alt: Gold band lying on a pale blue-grey tile: a brushed satin face between two beveled edges, each set with a row of small round lab-grown diamonds all the way around.
Close view of a beveled edge: small round lab-grown diamonds side by side with tiny gold beads between them, the thin polished lip above and the brushed satin face below, over blue-grey slate.
The band lying on charcoal slate, seen from the front: a row of round lab-grown diamonds along its top edge, a second row along its bottom edge and the brushed satin face between them.
A man's hand on charcoal grey wool wearing the band on the ring finger, its two rows of lab-grown diamonds crossing the finger on either side of the brushed face.
The band in yellow, white and rose gold side by side on pale limestone, each with a row of round lab-grown diamonds along both of its beveled edges.
The white gold band standing on sandstone, its opening framed by the full circle of round lab-grown diamonds on the near edge and the brushed face curving away.
The rose gold band on sage green linen seen from above: a complete circle of round lab-grown diamonds around the opening, the thin polished lip inside it and the brushed face outside.
The band resting in a man's open palm to show its size, a row of lab-grown diamonds along its top edge and another along its bottom edge.
The band standing on black basalt, seen along its axis: the row of round lab-grown diamonds forms one continuous circle around the opening, the polished inside beyond.
Drawing of the band from the side and in cross-section: about 6 mm wide and 1.8 mm thick, a row of round lab-grown diamonds of about 1.3 mm on each beveled edge, all the way round.
The ring on a red holder over a white towel on the workbench: the brushed satin face and a beveled edge with its row of small round lab-grown diamonds running around the band.
